faqs.q: Sec. 78-28. - Change in street elevation or grade.
faqs.a:
If any project will result in any substantial change in any existing street elevation
               or grade, it shall be sufficient for the notice required in this article merely so
               to state without stating a description of the extent or the location of such change.
               It shall not be necessary finally to establish the street elevation or grade line
               or to finalize completed plans until after the provisional order hearing, but prior
               to the time of the final passage of the ordinance creating the district.
(Code 1981, § 27-29; Ord. No. 551, § 13(G), 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 766, § 5, 6-16-1969)
